answers.core: From what I can tell there is no functionality in the engine (at the moment) that allows for users to add custom entries to built in context menus. If I am wrong though this whole proposal is completely redundant.
answers.workaround: Yes! If the user could extend the context menus in various parts of the engine from GDScript this could easily be made into a editor tool script someone could use from the asset library if they wanted to.

title: Add an "import files" dialog to the filesystem dock
